description: This Java source file defines the PartyHelper utility class for handling party-related data, including retrieving and formatting party names within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: PartyHelper
classes.description: A utility class providing methods to retrieve and format party names based on party data objects.

methods.name: getPartyName
methods.description: Retrieves the party name for a given GenericValue object, with an option to format last name first.

methods.name: getPartyName
methods.description: Retrieves the party name for a given delegator and partyId, with an option to format last name first.

methods.name: formatPartyNameObject
methods.description: Formats a party's name based on its attributes, supporting last name first formatting.
